changes.title: APD release notes
changes.text: Show concise APD-branded preview notes by default, with native categorized icons and individual popups.

changes.title: Retain complete technical history
changes.text: Keep every APK build record available through Versions without placing internal development sessions in the default release view.

changes.title: Release notes regression coverage
changes.text: Check player branding, preview dates, duplicates, categories, native icons, popup content, archive retention and compiled release-note integrity.

changes.title: Validate future player release notes
changes.text: Validate curated player notes during builds and compare their compiled contents with reviewed source without generating speculative announcements.

changes.title: Android 16 acceptance fixtures
changes.text: Retain the separate reused-APK Android 16 runner and input-fixture work without treating unsuccessful runs as passed gameplay checks.

changes.title: Record exact verification boundaries
changes.text: Retain owner delivery, localized wording and release-note preparation evidence while distinguishing pending Android and physical-phone checks.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I separated concise APD release notes from the complete technical APK archive. No historical build records or gameplay features were removed.

commentary: I separated APD release notes from technical build records while keeping the complete archive.
